edition.title: This weekend on Keowee + Jocassee
edition.dek: Jazz on the Alley's penultimate Thursday brings Funk Factory 5 to Ram Cat Alley, then both lakeside breweries run music four nights straight — Jennifer Gregory Band and Done Gone Boys Friday, Hammock Theory and The Warcry Duo Saturday. Walhalla's Main Street fills up for Walhalloween, Jocassee Lake Tours runs a six-hour waterfall tour and a Hunter's Moon night run, and Keowee Marina closes the weekend with a free Fall Festival Sunday afternoon.

events.title: Jazz on the Alley: Funk Factory 5
events.body: One of the last two Thursdays in this year's run — Funk Factory 5 takes Ram Cat Alley before the season wraps up October 29.
events.note: Free · Ram Cat Alley, downtown Seneca · music 7–9pm
events.source: City of Seneca · Visit Oconee SC

events.title: Jocassee Valley Brewing: Old Time Jam
events.body: Farm to Fire Fermentery's wood-fired pizza sets up for the day, then an old-time jam session takes over the evening.
events.note: Free · Music at 6:30pm · open 9am–9pm · Jocassee Valley Brewing, Salem

events.title: Friday night, two breweries: Jennifer Gregory Band and Done Gone Boys
events.body: Jocassee Valley Brewing has the Jennifer Gregory Band with Just A Smile's Caribbean food truck out front; across the water, Keowee Brewing has the Done Gone Boys playing downtown Seneca.
events.note: Free · Both start 6:30pm · Jocassee Valley Brewing, Salem & Keowee Brewing, 401 E. Main St, Seneca

events.title: Walhalloween: trick-or-treat on Main Street
events.body: Kids trick-or-treat along Walhalla's Main Street while a dog parade struts through Owens Park. The exact start time wasn't posted when we checked, so plan for the afternoon and confirm with the city before heading over.
events.note: Free · Main Street & Owens Park, Walhalla · time not yet posted
events.source: Visit Oconee SC · City of Walhalla

events.title: Jocassee Lake Tours: "All The Falls" Tour
events.body: A six-hour run past Jocassee's waterfalls. Seating is limited, so this one's worth booking ahead rather than showing up and hoping.
events.note: From $125 · 6 hours · limited seating · call to book

events.title: Saturday night, two breweries: Hammock Theory and The Warcry Duo
events.body: Jocassee Valley Brewing has Hammock Theory with Fresco Luna's food truck out front; Keowee Brewing has The Warcry Duo playing Southern rock downtown.
events.note: Free · Both start 6:30pm · Jocassee Valley Brewing, Salem & Keowee Brewing, Seneca

events.title: Keowee Marina's Fall Festival
events.body: Games, candy, vendors, a DJ, and costumes at the marina — a low-key family afternoon to close out the weekend.

events.title: Jocassee Lake Tours: Full Moon Rising Tour
events.body: A two-hour evening run timed to October's Hunter's Moon rising over the water.

events.title: Jocassee Valley Brewing: Conservation Theory
events.body: Conservation Theory closes out the weekend with an afternoon set, Farm to Fire Fermentery's food truck back for the day.
events.note: Free · Music at 4pm · open 12–7pm · Jocassee Valley Brewing, Salem

plan.title: Catch Jazz on the Alley, then decide how far you're driving
plan.body: Funk Factory 5 plays Ram Cat Alley at 7pm. Grab dinner downtown first if you'd rather not make the drive out to Salem after.
plan.label: Find a spot to eat & drink →

plan.title: Launch early — Saturday's stacked
plan.body: Walhalloween, the Jocassee waterfall tour, and both breweries' music are all happening Saturday. Get on the water in the morning before any of it starts.
plan.label: Find a ramp →

plan.title: A swim, the marina festival, then let the Hunter's Moon close it out
plan.body: Keowee Marina's Fall Festival runs 1–4pm. Pick a swim spot for the morning, and save Jocassee Lake Tours' Full Moon Rising Tour for the evening.
plan.label: Pick a swim spot →
